title: Changing Sentences to the Perfect Form

instruction.text: Change the sentences into the present perfect form.

hint.text: The present perfect form is used for events that have happened recently or are still happening now. It is formed with has/have + main past form verb.
hint.sound: The present perfect form is used for events that have happened recently or are still happening now. It is formed with 'has' or 'have' plus the main past form verb.

atoms.a: I <u>passed</u> all of my exams this year.
atoms.b: I ((have_passed)) all of my exams this year.

wrong.text: The verb 'saw' is the past form form of the irregular verb 'to see'. For the present perfect form, you need the past participle form of 'to see'.

atoms.a: Lola <u>planned</u> to tidy her room on Saturday.
atoms.b: Lola ((has_planned)) to tidy her room on Saturday.

atoms.a: We <u>asked</u> if we could have more time for the project.
atoms.b: We ((have_asked)) if we could have more time for the project.

instruction.text: Change the sentences into the past perfect form.

hint.text: The past perfect form is used for events that have happened before something else, and is formed with had + main past form verb.
hint.sound: The past perfect form is used for events that have happened before something else, and is formed with 'had' plus the main past form verb.

atoms.a: I <u>made</u> my bed before my mum came in to check.
atoms.b: I ((had_made)) my bed before my mum came in to check.

atoms.a: Grace <u>called</u> the hairdressers earlier in the day to make sure they were open.
atoms.b: Grace ((had_called)) the hairdressers earlier in the day to make sure they were open.

atoms.a: Zain <u>booked</u> tickets in advance for us to watch the football game last weekend.
atoms.b: Zain ((had_booked)) tickets in advance for us to watch the football game last weekend.

atoms.a: They <u>opened</u> their presents before they were allowed to.
atoms.b: They ((had_opened)) their presents before they were allowed to.
